name: Cursor BugBot
tagline: Cursor's PR reviewer scoped to bugs, security issues, and rule violations, billed per run (avg $1.00-1.50) since June 2026.
pricing: Usage-based since renewals after June 8, 2026: avg $1.00-1.50 per run (vendor estimate); bundled with Cursor plans (Pro from $20/mo), not sold standalone
selfHostedNote: Connects to self-hosted git (GHES, GitLab self-managed, Bitbucket Data Center) but the review service is SaaS-only.
modelControl: No BYOK or model choice; selectable effort levels only

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Reviews the diff plus rule files, surrounding code, and the PR comment thread; no codebase index.

02-rule-centric.note: Path-scoped .cursor/BUGBOT.md rules plus org-wide team rules; deliberately quiet, bug-only scope.

03-dual-workflow.note: PR-only reviewer; 'Fix in Cursor' hands findings to the editor, but there is no local review mode.

04-business-logic.note: No ticket or process integrations - deliberately out of scope.

05-continuous-learning.note: Generates learned repo rules from team activity; reads existing PR comments to avoid duplication.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented sandbox execution or test generation; static diff analysis with effort levels.

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK or model pinning; per-run cost (~$1.00-1.50) is visible but models are Cursor-selected.

08-actionability.note: 'Fix in Cursor' opens findings in the editor with context; no one-click commit from the PR itself.

09-measurable-roi.note: Cursor reports ~80% resolution rates for itself; customer-facing ROI dashboards not documented.
